payload.title: drift-notice shell test resolves a stale bin
payload.body: packages/canon/test/support/guardrail/test-deploy-drift-notice.sh reads Object.values(p.bin)[0] from packages/forge/package.json, which has had no bin since the command moved to the unscoped cratylus package, so the script fails before any assertion and nothing runs it in the gate.
